scope: Targeted primary metadata/chemistry search for new low-Fe operational-negative materials and independently certified Fe/Mg method/matrix blanks. This is a candidate intake, not a final campaign admission.

resolved_previous_blockers.detail: The registered PDS bundle DOI explicitly carries CC0-1.0 in DataCite, alongside the US-government-work statement. This supersedes a metadata-discovery blocker, not the scientific admission guards.
Record export/json and files API both work; catalogue has seven large numeric CSV assets and no separate README or chemistry attachment. No CSV content requested.
Chemistry rows and SuperLIBS XML labels are pinned for prospective low-Fe materials. These are point-estimate labels, not blank certification.
ALI appears in the retrieved prefix of the ChemLIBS product catalogue. Positive presence is confirmed; catalogue transfer was incomplete and neither product label nor intensity was opened.

sources.numeric_spectra_availability: PDS4 XML labels and product LID inventories; raw data content not accessed
sources.processing: PDS dark-subtracted, Ti-aligned, instrument-response-corrected for ChemLIBS/SuperLIBS; no baseline removal. pLIBS is reported in arbitrary units.
Published SuperLIBS 10K Earth/vacuum products use airPLS and per-region normalization. They must not be treated as identical to PDS products without a documented transformation.

operational_policy.blank_requirement: At least one independently certified method/matrix blank family with separately sourced finite FeOT and MgO upper bounds <=0.1 oxide wt %, traceable material/assay IDs and provenance.

Fe_oxide_conversion.interpretation: Stoichiometric reporting conversion of the reported Fe2O3* mass to equivalent FeO mass; does not establish oxidation state, exact absence, uncertainty, or a certified upper bound.

axis_evidence.finding: Ti wavelength alignment and a standard pLIBS axis are described, but no air/vacuum convention or numerical Ti reference atlas is identified. Vacuum labels describe measurement atmosphere.

axis_evidence.source: Lepore et al. 2018 SuperLIBS instrument paper
axis_evidence.finding: Ti alignment is analogous to ChemCam processing; this does not state the wavelength convention for exported SuperLIBS products.
Ti alignment and common-axis resampling are described; no wavelength-medium convention is provided.

axis_evidence.source: Belkhodja 2025, official repository extracted thesis text
axis_evidence.finding: Each run Ti spectrum is aligned with icoshift to a baseline spectrum, then the shift is applied to targets. The baseline reference axis is not identified as air or vacuum. The DH2000 section concerns instrument response.
Dark subtraction, Ti alignment, instrument-response correction, airPLS and region normalization; no explicit exported-axis medium. Published LOQ is model-derived and cannot certify chemical blanks.

previous_access_audit.session_reuse_exclusion: All inspected pLIBS Z300 labels report 2018-07-05Z, matching previously accessed 2018-07-05Z-run1.
previous_access_audit.limitations: A novel normalized ID is not proof of independent material/family/assay. SuperLIBS label date versus preprocessing filename inconsistencies must be reconciled before session-disjoint use.

blank_review.graphite: PDS GRAPHITE labels describe a natural terrestrial graphite mineral with unknown provider, not a linked certified pure reagent; Fe/Mg zeros in the chemistry table are unknown, not absence.
blank_review.dark: No-target/no-laser acquisitions are electronic dark measurements; no claim of a chemical method or matrix blank is made.
blank_review.point_estimates: Low nonzero Fe/Mg chemistry supports provisional operational-negative labels only. General method precision statements do not supply material-specific certified upper bounds.

blockers.required_evidence: A linked numeric measurement and independent assay/certificate naming the physical blank/family, matrix/method blank type, positive finite FeOT/MgO upper bounds <=0.1 wt %, and source hashes.
A product-specific explicit vacuum axis statement or explicit air axis with fixed documented air-to-vacuum conversion; chamber pressure is not sufficient.
Resolve material/assay aliases, preparation families and actual acquisition runs against all previously seen data; reconcile XML/file dates.
After metadata admission and frozen selection, retrieve permitted numeric products, pin raw SHA256 and validate shapes/axes; none were fetched for this audit.
